design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (appraisal_orders_and_fees)

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6, 6]. Tree = root + 1 prerequisite; both computations take 6 factors.

[Why a good test] The borrower asks for one thing: pay for the appraiser's follow-up visit before her slipped closing. The number she pays (880.00) is not a lookup: the agent must (1) read from the update-charge policy that the report age at the scheduled closing (170 days, loan file) triggers an update, (2) notice the prerequisite sentence 'The update visit charge is not fixed until the order's fee history carries the complexity add-on owed for the living area, site, market value, loan program and occupancy that the completed report and the loan file show.', (3) check the fee history (only a base-fee entry) and the report (5,180 sq ft, one unit, vs 4,000) to see the add-on is missing, (4) work out from the add-on policy that its own write is what brings that state about, compute it (575.00) from the report, the loan file and the arrival rule, book it on the card the base fee used, and only then (5) price the visit from six inputs spread over the order, its ledger, the loan file and the rate lock, and hand the payment to the borrower. Difficulty comes from policy reading, record reconciliation and arithmetic; there is exactly one tool per problem.

[Scope] Occupied before: nothing (task 0). Claimed: appraisal_ext_size_value_addon (agent, book_size_value_addon_5d867e2e, state_due) and appraisal_ext_update_inspection_charge (user, pay_update_inspection_charge_fc307ba0, on_request). Task 1 holds the missed-rush refund (refund_late_rush_charge_6e5bda3a) and the Form 1004D completion re-visit charge (pay_final_inspection_charge_e30bacb7); the completion charge expressly leaves to the update visit charge any order whose report is past its validity days at the scheduled closing, so the two 1004D policies never price the same visit.
Routing note (base frozen): the borrower's own decisions named by the blueprint (cancelling, submitting a reconsideration) carry no numeric field the schema can persist, while every problem must carry a computation; the customer's own write is therefore the borrower authorising, from her own card, the charge for a new Form 1004D service (appraisal_fee_charged, a claimed event). Charges on the card already on file for the original order stay agent-booked.

[Problem-tree card] root = appraisal_ext_update_inspection_charge (owner=user). Edge root -> appraisal_ext_size_value_addon: kind value_input, gate binding billed_addon, form state, sentence (negated direction, 'not ... until'): see above. Four-point test: ordering connective 'not ... until'; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a charge on the order's fee history for the add-on); no tool, id or code token; strength 'not fixed until' with scope 'the complexity add-on owed' (one add-on per order, collected once). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a gross-living-area surcharge line: the add-on policy's target tool. Derivation: sentence + fee history (no such line) + the add-on policy rule ('booked as one charge on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line') -> book the add-on. Unresolved at frozen_time: appraisal_fee_ledger holds only 7b07b2ae (base_fee 1150.00); fee_balance 1150.00; GLA 5180. Topological order: add-on (action 7) then payment (action 9). Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping the add-on -> charge 760.00 instead of 880.00. user_scenario never names the add-on; tools validate nothing.

[Factor card — add-on, expected 575.00, whole baseline 250.00]
- living_area_overage_tier (parameter, reads loan units): 5,180 per unit, 1,180 sq ft over -> 1.4x250 = 350.00; baseline 250 -> result 475.00.
- market_value_tier (parameter, cross loan property_value 1,240,000) -> 125.00; baseline 0 -> 450.00.
- loan_program_tier (parameter, cross loan Jumbo) -> 100.00; baseline -> 475.00.
- occupancy_tier (parameter, cross loan second_home) -> 60.00; baseline -> 515.00.
- site_acreage_tier (parameter, multi-source: order site size AND loan property type, cross loan) -> 40.00; baseline -> 535.00.
- arrival_lateness_method (method: which formula the add-on takes — living-area part alone / subtotal less a flat amount floored at the living-area part / whole subtotal): completed 2 days after due -> max(350, 675-100) = 575.00; baseline whole subtotal -> 675.00. Near-miss: delivered 2026-05-26 (6 days after due) would select the living-area-only formula; the rule reads the completed date.
- Once-only netting: nothing stands on the gross-living-area line, so 0.00 is taken off. HPML flip exclusion: standard_order, not excluded.
[Factor card — update visit charge, expected 880.00, whole baseline 250.00]
- note_date_age_tier (cross loan estimated_closing_date): 170 days -> 75.00; baseline -> 805.00. Near-miss: the contract closing date 2026-07-17 is stale (closing moved) and would give 65 days (no update at all).
- billed_addon_class (history, value_input): 575.00 standing -> 120.00; baseline -> 760.00.
- lock_horizon_tier (cross lock): lock 94da561e expires 2026-10-23, 9 days -> 125.00; baseline -> 755.00.
- value_cushion_tier (cross loan): appraised 1,250,000 is 0.81 percent above the loan file's 1,240,000 property value -> full market-conditions refresh 100.00; baseline -> 780.00.
- loan_amount_tier (cross loan base 992,000) -> 60.00; baseline -> 820.00. Near-miss: property value 1,240,000 would select 120.00.
- visit_scope_method (method: combined visit adds a completion part / desktop recert flat / standard): value subject to completion -> 730+150 = 880.00; baseline 730.00.
Task floors: multi-source = site_acreage_tier (order site_acres AND loan property_type are distinct records); cross-difficulty = market_value/loan_program/occupancy/site (loan), note_date_age/value_cushion/loan_amount (loan), lock_horizon (lock).

[Base-invariant card] Write subject appraisal_fee_charged (both writes). Governing base policies: appraisal_fee_schedule (gate after_itp_only: loan file status conditionally_approved is in the allowed set; evidence loan_files.366a5afa.status, correlated by loan_file_id passed to the tool); appraisal_validity_and_update and appraisal_hpml_flip_second_appraisal (no structured gate; policy_scope: report age 170 within 365 with update; file not HPML and the order is not an HPML flip second appraisal, which both policies exclude in their own rules). No time gate on these writes. Overwrites declared: add-on — fee_schedule gla sentence and the 'no stacking or discount' sentence; update charge — validity_and_update update-charge clause, fee_schedule 'reinspection_fee is charged once for each Form 1004D' sentence and the 'no stacking or discount' sentence; each replacement carries its still-in-force parts (update by the original appraiser keeps the report usable; a report past its maximum age is replaced by a new order) and names the sibling policies' cases, and the base rush charge at order stays in force (the lock-horizon part is a turn-time premium inside the update visit charge, not a rush charge). Nothing of this task charges for a reconsideration of value.

[Business-object card] Target object: appraisal order 61a92b46 (single order of the customer) on loan file 366a5afa. Rows read: base-fee entry (payment method credit_card -> card for the add-on), rate lock 94da561e (locked). Not seeded: the lock request log, the loan's up-front fee ledger and any reconsideration record (no read of this task reaches them; the loan file's prepaid_fee_balance 787.40 = credit report 92.40 + Jumbo application fee 695.00 stands as the loan desk's record). Each write names the order and the loan file.

[Seed rationale] Jumbo second home in Huron OH (price 1,240,000; base 992,000; 80.00 LTV <= 85); Complex Property report by report-type selection; closing slipped from the contract date 2026-07-17 to 2026-10-30 (seller's seawall repair -> subject to completion), which ages the report past 120 days; the AMC report arrived 2 days late; GLA measured 5,180 (above threshold) with no surcharge yet booked — the state_due add-on. Automatic clauses checked: no rush, no hold, no cancellation, not HPML, base loan below the 1,500,000 second-appraisal threshold, acreage 2.60 below the 5-acre acreage surcharge, delivery within 3 business days: nothing else owed. The completion charge policy leaves this order to the combined update visit (report past validity at the scheduled closing).

[Persona] Nora Fenwick, organised and short on time; opening states only the slipped closing and the follow-up visit she wants to pay; phone at opening, DOB/ZIP only when asked; passive agreement if told another charge goes on the original card; pays the visit with her debit card when handed the payment; stops when told it is paid.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> find_appraisal_orders -> find_loan_files -> find_appraisal_fee_ledger -> find_rate_locks -> unlock+call add-on (575.00, credit_card) -> unlock_user + borrower pays 880.00 by debit_card.

[Verification run] check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on the world replayed through the real tools up to each call (scratch script deleted after closing; re-run with: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0059_residential_mortgage_lender/tasks/appraisal_orders_and_fees --task 0 -> COMPUTE OK): add-on 575.0, sensitivities 475/450/475/515/535/675, baseline 250; update charge 880.0, sensitivities 805/760/755/780/820/730, baseline 250; skipping the add-on write -> 760.0.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the two policy texts, the tool schemas and the five lookups: update needed (170 days), add-on missing (no surcharge line), add-on 575.00 from report+loan file+arrival rule, card = base-fee card; then 880.00. Agrees with gold.

[Revision log — audit round 1] F-1 (reconsideration part charged the borrower for exercising a reconsideration of value, against base 'Nothing is charged for a reconsideration of value' / 'The borrower is never charged'): the reconsideration factor was removed and replaced by value_cushion_tier (market-conditions refresh when the appraised value barely clears the property value); the reconsideration read and the two reconsideration rows were dropped (nothing reads them now); update charge 820.00 -> 880.00, skip-edge 700.00 -> 760.00, terminal fee_balance 2545.00 -> 2605.00. O-1: the completion charge now excludes orders past validity at the scheduled closing, and the combined visit tier applies to every order subject to completion. O-3: the add-on nets off any amount already on its line. O-9: HPML flip second appraisals excluded from both charges. O-10: the 'no stacking' sentence declared in each charge policy, each replacement scoped to its own parts and naming the siblings'. O-11: the appraiser-turnaround condition removed; the living-area tier reads per-unit area from the loan file. O-12: the 1-2-day arrival tier is floored at the living-area part. O-T0-1: the multi-source factor named above is site_acreage_tier.

[Revision log — render round 1] Source-only fixes, no scored value moved (add-on 575.00, update charge 880.00): the 'rush_fee is charged once when the borrower asks for rush' overwrite withdrawn (no conflict; base rush at order stays in force); the update-clause replacement now carries 'by the original appraiser keeps the report usable' and the new-order case; the reinspection and no-stacking replacements are scoped to this policy's parts and name the sibling policies' cases; the living-area bands read 'at least 500 but under 1,500' as compute does.

[Revision log — render round 2] Wording only, no scored value moved (add-on 575.00, update charge 880.00): the add-on's no-stacking replacement now says it is reduced by two things only, its arrival rule and any amount already standing on its own line, matching the netting sentence and compute; tool docstrings say amounts are 'stored rounded to 2 decimal places', matching round() in the bodies.
user_scenario:
You are Nora Fenwick, 47, a hospital pharmacy manager from Dublin, Ohio, buying a second home on Lake Erie at 2846 Lakeshore Drive in Huron with a Larkspur jumbo loan. You are organised, polite and a little short on time because you are calling from work. You open by saying that your closing on the lake house has been pushed to October 30, that your processor told you the appraisal will be too old by then and that the appraiser still has to come back out anyway to sign off on the seawall repair the sellers finished, and that you want to pay for the appraiser's follow-up visit today so it is not holding anything up. You are asking for that one thing: to settle and pay for the follow-up visit on the appraisal you already have; you are not asking for a new appraisal, a refund or any change to your loan or your rate lock.
You give your phone number, 6145552638, as soon as the agent asks how to find you. If the agent asks for something else to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1979-08-03; only if asked for more you give your mailing ZIP code, 43017. You do not know any reference numbers by heart and say the agent will have to look them up. You do not know what the visit costs and you never suggest an amount; if the agent asks whether you know the price, you say you were hoping they could tell you.
If the agent tells you that some other appraisal charge has to be put on the order first and that it goes on the card the appraisal was originally paid with, you say that is fine, put it on the same card, and you do not ask for it to be taken off or reduced. When the agent hands you the payment for the follow-up visit to complete yourself, you pay it with your debit card, not the credit card the appraisal was first paid with, and you read back the confirmation you see. If the agent asks how you want to pay before handing it over, you say your debit card. Once the agent tells you the follow-up visit is paid and on the order, you thank them and say goodbye; you do not raise anything else.

gold_actions.business_effect: Books the complexity add-on owed on the delivered Form 1004 Jumbo report as one charge on the gross-living-area surcharge line, collected on the credit card the base fee was paid with.

request_binding.action_semantics: The complexity add-on is a state_due charge: the completed report states 5,180 square feet against a 4,000 square foot threshold and no surcharge line stands on the order, and the update visit charge the customer asked to pay is not fixed until the order's fee history carries that add-on.

discriminator.business_meaning: complexity add-on on the gross-living-area surcharge line of an order whose report states a living area above the threshold

stage_provenance.fact: The completed report (completed 2026-05-22, delivered 2026-05-26) already states the living area and site size; the add-on is owed on that pre-existing record and is booked by this call.

base_preconditions.condition: Appraisal charges are collected only while the loan file status is processing, underwriting, conditionally_approved, suspended or clear_to_close.

A report supports the note only while its age from inspection_date to the note date is within validity_days; between validity_days and max_age_with_update_days a Form 1004D update keeps it usable; a value subject to completion needs a Form 1004D completion inspection before funding.
The HPML flip second appraisal rule applies only to a purchase on a loan file flagged hpml_flag true; this file is not HPML, so no second appraisal and no not-chargeable charge is involved.

gold_actions.business_effect: The borrower pays, with her debit card, the combined Form 1004D update-and-completion visit charge on her appraisal order.

seed_consistency.check: Jumbo file, single-family detached second home at 80 percent base LTV: the default interior report for a Jumbo file is the Complex Property Appraisal (eligible program, property type, purpose, 1 unit, LTV 80.00 <= 85.00). Ordered Monday 2026-05-04 at standard speed, due 2026-05-20 is 12 business days later (Memorial Day is 05-25, after). Inspected 05-13, completed 05-22 (2 days late), delivered 05-26 (Friday 05-22 is day zero, Monday 05-25 a holiday, Tuesday 05-26 business day 1 of 3). Status delivered. fee_balance 1150.00 equals the single base-fee charge.
Base fee 1150.00 of the Complex Property report charged once at order on 2026-05-04, after intent to proceed (2026-04-23), on a credit card (an accepted method); no other component was charged.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's borrower profile from the phone number she gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the customer reference number this lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify Nora Fenwick with two credentials she states: phone number and date of birth.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Appraisal business may only be discussed or transacted for a verified customer.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her appraisal order: report type, order reason, due, inspection, completed and delivered dates, stated gross living area, site size and appraised value, the completion flag and the net charges paid.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The report type sets the reinspection fee, surcharge and thresholds; the dates feed the arrival rule and the report age; the stated living area, the appraised value and the completion flag decide both computations.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the loan file the order supports: program, occupancy, property type, units, property value, base loan amount and the closing date currently scheduled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The per-unit living area and the market-value, loan-program, occupancy and site parts of the complexity add-on, and the report-age, market-conditions and loan-amount parts of the update visit charge, are decided from these loan-file fields.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the order's fee history: one base-fee charge on the credit card and no gross-living-area surcharge or reinspection charge yet.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the complexity add-on the update visit charge waits on is not yet on the order (and that nothing already stands on that line to net off), gives the card the add-on is collected on, and shows no recent reinspection charge for the visit-scope rule.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the locked rate lock on the loan file and its expiration date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The lock-horizon part of the update visit charge counts the calendar days from today to that expiration date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the tool that books the complexity add-on on the order.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the complexity add-on owed on the order, collected on the card the base fee was collected with.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The complexity add-on policy is owed on this order and the update visit charge is not fixed until the order's fee history carries it.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appraisal_order_id: 61a92b46-5b96-4c1f-94c6-6f1d0a54ff98 — basis: the appraisal order lookup for the verified customer returns exactly one order, the Complex Property Appraisal on the Huron loan file; the tool docstring asks for the reference number of the order the add-on is booked on. Uniqueness: the customer holds one appraisal order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_file_id: 366a5afa-0773-449a-8f29-5caee50444da — basis: the loan_file_id field of that appraisal order (and the loan file lookup). Uniqueness: an order belongs to exactly one loan file.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.addon_amount: 575.00 — living-area part 350.00 (5,180 sq ft over 1 unit on the loan file = 5,180 per unit; overage 5,180 - 4,000 = 1,180 sq ft is at least 500 and under 1,500, so 1.4 x gla_surcharge 250.00); market-value part 125.00 (loan file property_value 1,240,000.00 is in 1,000,000-1,499,999.99); loan-program part 100.00 (Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed); occupancy part 60.00 (second_home); site part 40.00 (2.60 acres, single_family_detached, in 1 to under 3); subtotal 675.00; arrival rule: completed 2026-05-22 is DAYS(2026-05-20, 2026-05-22) = 2 days after due, so subtotal less 100.00 = 575.00, which is not below the living-area part 350.00; nothing stands on the gross-living-area line to net off (0.00); standard_order, not an HPML flip; kept to the cent.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: credit_card — basis: the add-on policy says it is 'collected on the card or account the order's base fee was collected with', and the fee history shows the base-fee entry paid by credit_card. Uniqueness: debit_card and ach_debit are not the method of the base-fee entry; the borrower's own later choice of debit card applies only to the payment she makes herself.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Hand the update visit payment over to the borrower.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The update visit charge is paid by the borrower in her own name; the agent unlocks the payment for her.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The borrower pays the combined update-and-completion visit charge with her debit card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the customer's request: pay for what keeps the appraisal usable for the October 30 closing.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appraisal_order_id: 61a92b46-5b96-4c1f-94c6-6f1d0a54ff98 — basis: the same single appraisal order the agent read to the borrower before handing over the payment; docstring: 'reference number of the borrower's appraisal order the update visit is for'. Uniqueness: one order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_file_id: 366a5afa-0773-449a-8f29-5caee50444da — basis: the loan_file_id on that order, read to the borrower by the agent. Uniqueness: one loan file per order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_amount: 880.00 — reinspection fee 250.00 (Complex Property report) + report-age part 75.00 (DAYS(2026-05-13, 2026-10-30) = 170 days, in 151-210) + billed add-on part 120.00 (the add-on standing after the add-on write is 575.00 >= 400) + lock-horizon part 125.00 (locked 60-day lock expires 2026-10-23, DAYS(2026-10-14, 2026-10-23) = 9, in 8-14, so 50 percent of rush fee 250.00) + market-conditions part 100.00 (appraised value 1,250,000.00 is above the loan file's property value 1,240,000.00 by 0.81 percent, under 1 percent) + loan-amount part 60.00 (base loan 992,000.00 in 900,000-1,499,999.99) = standard update charge 730.00; visit scope: subject_to_completion is true, so the combined visit adds 60 percent of 250.00 = 150.00, giving 880.00. The age gate holds: 170 > validity 120 and <= 365; the order is a standard_order, not an HPML flip second appraisal.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: debit_card — basis: user_scenario 'you pay it with your debit card', and the docstring enum 'debit_card when the borrower pays with a debit card'. Uniqueness: the borrower states the debit card; credit_card is the original appraisal card she explicitly does not use, ach_debit is not offered.

factor_trace: living_area_overage_tier (parameter): stated GLA 5,180 over the loan file's 1 unit = 5,180 per unit; overage over the 4,000 threshold = 1,180 (at least 500, under 1,500) -> 1.4 x 250.00 = 350.00; baseline reading is the surcharge itself, 250.00.
market_value_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): loan file property_value 1,240,000.00 -> 1,000,000-1,499,999.99 tier -> 125.00; baseline adds nothing.
loan_program_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): loan file program Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed -> 100.00; baseline adds nothing.
occupancy_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): loan file occupancy second_home -> 60.00; baseline adds nothing.
site_acreage_tier (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty loan): site 2.60 acres on a single_family_detached property -> 1 to under 3 acres -> 40.00; baseline adds nothing.

arrival_lateness_method (method): due 2026-05-20, completed 2026-05-22 -> 2 days late -> subtotal less a flat 100.00, floored at the living-area part: max(350.00, 675.00 - 100.00) = 575.00; the standard method keeps the whole subtotal (675.00). Near-miss: the delivered date 2026-05-26 (6 days after due) would wrongly select the living-area-only method (350.00).

plumbing: per-unit overage 1,180 > 0 and order_reason standard_order (not an HPML flip), so the add-on is owed; nothing stands on the gross-living-area line (0.00 netted off); result kept to the cent = 575.00.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: gross living area per dwelling unit exceeds the threshold by at least 500 but under 1,500 square feet
site of 1 to under 3 acres, not a condominium
completed 1 or 2 days after its due date (subtotal less 100, floored at the living-area part)

factor_trace: note_date_age_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): inspection 2026-05-13 to the loan file's estimated_closing_date 2026-10-30 = 170 days -> 151-210 -> 75.00; baseline adds nothing. Near-miss: the stale contract closing date 2026-07-17 would give 65 days (no update at all).

billed_addon_class (parameter, history): after the add-on write the gross-living-area surcharge line carries 575.00 charged, 0.00 refunded -> 575.00 >= 400 -> 120.00; baseline adds nothing (and before the add-on write the standing add-on is 0.00, which also adds nothing).

lock_horizon_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty lock): locked Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock expires 2026-10-23 -> 9 days from 2026-10-14 -> 8-14 tier -> 50 percent of rush fee 250.00 = 125.00; baseline adds nothing.

value_cushion_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): appraised value 1,250,000.00 vs loan file property_value 1,240,000.00 -> 0.81 percent above, under 1 percent -> full market-conditions refresh 100.00; baseline adds nothing.

loan_amount_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty loan): base loan amount 992,000.00 -> 900,000-1,499,999.99 -> 60.00; baseline adds nothing. Near-miss: property value 1,240,000.00 would select the 120.00 tier; the rule reads the base loan amount.
visit_scope_method (method): subject_to_completion true -> combined visit = standard update charge 730.00 + 60 percent of 250.00 = 880.00; the standard method charges 730.00.
gates and plumbing: update_needed (170 > 120 and <= 365, standard_order) true; standard update charge = 250.00 + 75.00 + 120.00 + 125.00 + 100.00 + 60.00 = 730.00; result 880.00.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: 151 to 210 days old at the scheduled closing date
standing add-on of 400 dollars or more
lock expires 8 to 14 calendar days from today
appraised value above the loan file's property value by less than 1 percent

edges.condition: The order's fee history shows a gross-living-area surcharge charge equal to the complexity add-on the completed report and the loan file call for, so the billed add-on standing on the order equals that add-on.
edges.policy_source: The update visit charge is not fixed until the order's fee history carries the complexity add-on owed for the living area, site, market value, loan program and occupancy that the completed report and the loan file show.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The order's fee history holds only the base-fee charge; no gross-living-area surcharge line exists although the report states 5,180 square feet (one unit) against a 4,000 square foot threshold, so the standing add-on is 0.00 instead of the 575.00 owed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The add-on write (action 7) books a 575.00 charge on the gross-living-area surcharge line; billed_addon becomes 575.00 and fee_balance 1725.00, so the billed add-on part of the update visit charge moves from 0.00 to 120.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the add-on must be written before the update visit charge is evaluated, because the charge reads the standing add-on. Reversing the order gives a charge of 760.00 instead of 880.00 (replayed with the add-on write skipped), so only add-on-then-charge reaches the gold terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the add-on write: the gross-living-area surcharge line stays empty, billed_addon = 0.00, the billed add-on part drops from 120.00 to 0.00 and the update visit charge from 880.00 to 760.00; the terminal ledger also lacks the 575.00 add-on entry and fee_balance ends 1910.00 instead of 2605.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to pay for the appraiser's follow-up visit; it never mentions a surcharge, an add-on, the size of the house, the gross-living-area line or any charge that must come first. The only related line is a passive reaction: if the agent says another appraisal charge has to be put on the order first, she agrees to the same card.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_update_inspection_charge_fc307ba0 creates the reinspection charge and raises fee_balance with whatever amount is passed; it never reads the gross-living-area line or checks that an add-on stands, and returns status paid in every case. book_size_value_addon_5d867e2e likewise books any amount without checks.
